$comment: The author registry. Every published blog post's `author` frontmatter must match an entry here (by a shared sameAs URL, or exact name) — check-source-rules fails the commit otherwise, because a byline that links nowhere is a credential nobody can verify. Each entry renders a page at /author/<slug>: bio, profiles, and everything they wrote. Filled by /onboard-marketing; a guest author gets their own entry (real profile, real bio), never a borrowed one.
